title: The copy link button quietly wins
dek: In the defaults, sharing by copying the link carries a bigger weight than sharing by DM.
whatChanged: In the defaults, a share through copy link has a weight of 20.0. A share sent by DM is 5.0, and a general share is 2.118. Copy link has the largest weight of those three share types in this list. These are defaults in the public repo, and live settings can differ.
meaningForCreators: Sharing by copying a link is the strongest share signal in these defaults. A post a reader would want to pass to a friend on purpose is worth writing for. Make the first line say what the post gives the reader.
action: Do this: write one post a week that someone would want to send to a friend, and make the first line say what it is.
